workExperienceSection.workDescription:
• Built the ranking model behind podcast search results, which raised plays per search by 6% in a four-week A/B test
• Designed the company's experimentation guidelines and a sample-size calculator now used by 12 product teams
• Forecast weekly listening for 3,000 podcasts with gradient-boosted models, helping the ad sales team plan seasonal campaigns and cut unsold ad inventory by 8% over the summer
• Partner with product managers to turn search and listening questions into dashboards and experiments

• Built a churn model for checking accounts and a Tableau dashboard that branch managers use every week to call at-risk customers, which cut account closures by 12% in pilot branches
• Automated the monthly regulatory report in Python and SQL, turning three days of spreadsheet work into an hour
• Segmented 2 million credit card customers by spending patterns in Python and SQL, giving the marketing team four audiences for cash back offers that raised monthly card spending by 5% in a test
• Taught a weekly SQL class for 25 analysts in finance and operations who were new to the data warehouse

• Measured how send times affect opens for a cooking newsletter with 2 million subscribers, then moved the daily send to the best-performing hour, which raised open rates by 4 points in a month
• Built a weekly email report on subscriber growth that replaced a spreadsheet the editors updated by hand

projectsSection.projectDescription: • Interactive map of five years of public subway delay data that shows which lines and hours are worst, viewed by more than 20,000 people after a local news site shared it with its readers

• Model that estimates fair rent for New York apartments from public listings, built to help friends spot overpriced leases
• Scraped 40,000 listings over six months and published the cleaned data set for other students to reuse
